name: Monster Taming
description: Weaken it, catch it, raise it, and take it somewhere that tests it. The pack is built on the Pet Sim kit rather than beside it, because a captured creature and a raised pet want the same care systems -- the difference is that this genre also fights. Capture is a probability the player can influence, which is the design that makes a throw feel earned rather than random; pets.monster_dex turns that into completion pressure; and pets.evolution_tree makes the same species branch on how it was played rather than on a menu choice. The gym gauntlet is the campaign spine and the badge is its durable output, read by world gates rather than inferred from a win.
loop: encounter wild → weaken → capture → build team → battle gyms

signatureCompound.name: Caught, Raised, Evolved, Registered
signatureCompound.description: One creature through the whole pack: capture_mechanic resolves a weaken-and-throw into a catch, team_composition finds it a slot or a box, evolution_tree offers a branch once it has been levelled and trained, and monster_dex records both forms -- which is the reason evolution_tree's completed event carries the old species id as well as the new one. Without that field the registry would lose half the collection.
